stories.title: RBI raises repo rate 25 bps as inflation broadens, puts cuts on hold
stories.summary: India’s central bank raised its benchmark repo rate by 25 basis points to address rising inflation, with many commodities posting price gains above 4%. Governor Sanjay Malhotra said inflation is becoming generalized, and Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta highlighted external supply‑side shocks as a key driver. External members warned that aggressive tightening could dampen growth, leaving future rate cuts on ice.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: India targets 25 % manufacturing share of GDP, AI seen as key boost
stories.summary: In a discussion hosted by the Economic Times, PwC India partner Vinod Kumar and JSW Group chief digital officer Srihari Kaninghat examined India’s goal of raising manufacturing’s contribution from about 16 % to 25 % of GDP. They explained how AI on the shop floor can reduce material costs, forecast equipment failures, and improve the sector’s appeal to engineering talent, while noting that moving AI from pilots to broader deployment remains a hurdle.
stories.why: Achieving the target is a stated policy objective for expanding manufacturing’s role in the economy.
stories.previousTitle: India targets 25% of GDP from manufacturing, AI seen as catalyst
stories.previousSummary: In a video discussion, Vinod Kumar of PwC India and Srihari Kaninghat of JSW Group examined how artificial intelligence could help raise India’s manufacturing share of GDP from about 16 % to a stated goal of 25 %. They cited AI‑driven cost cuts, predictive maintenance of equipment and the aim to draw engineering talent back to industry. The speakers noted that most AI initiatives are still in pilot phases.

stories.title: Bank of Canada expected to raise rates at Oct. 28 meeting
stories.summary: The Bank of Canada has held its policy rate at 2.25% since a quarter-point cut in October 2025, with an eighth consecutive hold widely predicted for next week. A growing number of economists and traders now expect the central bank to raise rates to curb stubborn inflation, though that view is less settled than the consensus for keeping rates unchanged.
stories.why: Inflation data can shift expectations for central-bank interest rates, bond yields, borrowing costs and household purchasing power.

stories.title: Jio Platforms IPO analysis examines potential impact on Reliance Industries shareholders
stories.summary: A video from Economic Times examines how the upcoming Jio Platforms stock market listing could affect the value of Reliance Industries Ltd.’s shares. The discussion focuses on the holding‑company discount, estimates the worth of Reliance’s stake in Jio, and explains why the IPO might change investor perception of Reliance.
stories.why: Investors may need to reassess Reliance’s valuation based on the Jio IPO’s effect.

stories.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
stories.summary: Flint is a free coding model that can run on a laptop and was built largely with the help of AI. For now, Recursive’s version is more limited: an AI research assistant overseen by people that produced a model small enough for a laptop.
stories.why: This matters because it could change AI capabilities, costs, adoption, regulation or competitive positioning.
